toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

toolDefinitions.name: update_plan
toolDefinitions.description: Choose the next allowed tool and record a short observable objective. This choice gates execution; replan after failures.

data.summary: Demo pricing analysis for headset-stand as of 2026-10-24 using synthetic product costs and synthetic direct channel rule. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with a 10% discount applied to each target. Undiscounted prices were BRL 38.10, 44.45, and 53.34; discounted charged prices were BRL 34.29, 40.01, and 48.01. The discount reduces realized revenue margin below the target in all three cases, while contribution remains positive in each scenario.
assumptions: Product costs are synthetic demonstration data (status: Demonstration) from demo-costs-v1 and are not confirmed business data.
Channel rule is synthetic demonstration data (status: Demonstration) from demo-rule-v1 with 10% channel fee, zero tax, zero advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
All charges are modeled on the same revenue basis as returned by the deterministic calculator.
The reported contribution includes the tool's failure-provision assumption and full-print retry modeling; it is not net profit.
A 10% discount was applied to each target margin scenario exactly as requested.
limitations: Full-print retry assumption is embedded in the calculator and may differ from operational reality.
No marketplace verification is available for current fees or policy conditions.
Revenue margin is distinct from markup; markup values shown by the tool should not be read as revenue margin.
Prices are drafts and require human approval; no application or publication is possible.
